user.title: Lumina Feeds
user.description:
Set up personalized news and stock data.

After setup, configure your interests and stocks in the integration options.

interests.title: News Interests
interests.description:
One feed per line. Two modes:

**Direct RSS URL** (recommended for quality):
Tech | https://feeds.arstechnica.com/arstechnica/index
BBC | https://feeds.bbci.co.uk/news/world/rss.xml
Verge | https://www.theverge.com/rss/index.xml

**Google News search** (keyword-based):
Smart Home | home assistant, smart home | en
Local | Tel Aviv | he

stocks.title: Edit Stock Symbols
stocks.description:
Edit or remove symbols. Comma-separated.
Stocks: AAPL, MSFT, TSLA
Crypto: BTC-USD, ETH-USD
Indices: ^GSPC, ^DJI
ETFs: SPY, QQQ

stock_search.title: Search & Add Stocks
stock_search.description:
Type a company name, stock symbol, or crypto name to search.

Examples: **NVIDIA**, **Apple**, **Bitcoin**, **S&P 500**

stock_results.title: Search Results
stock_results.description: Select the stocks you want to add:

intervals.title: Update Intervals
intervals.description: How often to fetch new data (in minutes).

error.no_results: No results found. Try a different search term.
error.unsafe_url: That URL points at a private/internal address and was rejected for safety. Please use a public RSS feed URL.
error.invalid_url: That doesn't look like a valid http(s) URL.
error.invalid_symbol: One or more symbols don't look like valid Yahoo Finance tickers (letters, digits, '^', '.', '=', '-').
error.too_many_interests: Too many interests — please keep it under 50.
error.too_many_symbols: Too many symbols — please keep it under 100.
error.line_too_long: One of your lines is too long (max 500 characters).
